name: landing-page-business-suite
description: Authoritative catalog of the Landing Page Business Suite CLI. Current commands are local REST façade commands; they are intentionally cataloged as local until each domain is migrated to generated Connect clients.

groups.name: legacy
groups.description: Current flat local command surface; migrate command-by-command to proto-first domain groups without changing behavior.
